$comment: Ground truth for the pushup rep counter, labelled by hand on 2026-09-18 by the Phase 5 SPEC agent from frame contact sheets (4 fps, plus the Python shoulder-height trace as an aid; the counts come from the frames). One entry per clip. `reps` lists every completed top -> bottom -> top cycle with the time of its lowest point. `form` is judged against the definition in `definition`. `confidence` = high when the frames leave no doubt, medium when a reasonable coach could disagree. Acceptance: `total` within +/-1 (see `total_tolerance`), and the app's good-rep count within [good_min - 1, good_max + 1]. `not_reps` are movements that must NOT be counted. Clips with `committed: false` are personal recordings kept outside the repo (absolute path on Kalp's Mac).

definition.rep: One top -> bottom -> top cycle of the shoulders. The clip must reach a top (plank, arms straight) before the first counted bottom; a clip that starts mid-descent does not get that rep. A dip shallower than about half the person's full range is a partial and is not a rep.
definition.good_form: Straight line from shoulders through hips to ankles at the top AND at the bottom (no hip sag, no arched lower back, no piked hips), chest near the floor at the bottom, arms straight at the top. This is what the one-pager calls 'form quality based on body position' and what the training clips in data/good_form show.
definition.bad_form: Any of: hips sagging or lower back arched (the 'worm', hips lagging the chest on the way up), hips piked up (downward-dog shape), knees on the floor, resting the hips on the floor then pushing the chest up first, partial depth counted as a rep. This is what data/bad_form shows.
definition.source_of_definition: One-pager 'AI-Powered Pushup Form Tracker' (Kalp Kansara & Yash Panchal): 'Instant feedback on form quality based on body position', 'Repetition counting with form validation', 'detect valid pushup repetitions based on timing and the top-of-rep form'; plus the labelled training folders data/good_form and data/bad_form in ~/Desktop/Out and About/Sidequest/AI_Pushup_Tracking.
